name: MLSC 4312
title: Hematology Laboratory
description: Application of the theory and techniques learned in MLSC 4311  to the clinical laboratory setting. Understanding work flow, teamwork, evaluation of normal and abnormal results, instrumentation and quality assurance in the general laboratory environment. Correlation of blood cell morphology and laboratory data in normal and disease states.
requirement_description: A grade of C or better in MLSC 4311; open only to Medical Laboratory Sciences majors and Medical Laboratory Sciences certificate students; others with consent of Medical Laboratory Sciences Program Director.
